description: BMW E46 M3 (S54) MSS54HP: read a drive log (Testo CSV, or TUNER's own CSV) and report its channels, how many rows the VE and rf_korr calculations can use, and why the rest were left out — each reason with what to change on the next drive. Attach the BIN it was driven on for the DME's own lambda thresholds.

bin_file.description: The 64 KB (65,536-byte) MSS54HP calibration partial ("0401 partial BIN").
